references.text: In Matthew 13:10-17, the disciples also ask Jesus why he speaks to the people in parables, which mirrors the event in Mark 4:10.
In Luke 8:9-10, we find a parallel situation where Jesus' disciples ask him about the meaning of the parables, similar to Mark 4:10.
Psalm 78:2 mentions the use of parables to convey messages, which can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' use of parables in Mark 4:10.
In Isaiah 6:9-10, which Jesus quotes in explaining why he uses parables (Mark 4:12), we find a direct connection to the event in Mark 4:10.
